cases.purpose: Independently observe explicit missing numeric primary GID versus shadow-utils on isolated guest account roots, with a positive existing-group reference control and both candidate observations retained. Separate owner-corrected repeat: candidate account directories and files are owned by the executing root UID and candidate existing-GID success is a required positive control. Separately named root-only ptrace diagnostic; preserves expected positive outcome, reports syscall return/errno without inspecting secret buffers. Clock and descendant denials retained.
cases.oracle: Prepared Debian shadow-utils useradd 1:4.17.4-2 under --root in a private disposable guest fixture, with an existing-group positive control and a missing-group diagnostic plus byte-identical negative control. The original product fixture remains untouched.
cases.comparison: Reference asserts missing-group rejection and existing-group success; candidate existing-group must succeed as a validity control. Candidate missing-group return, diagnostics and records remain observations with no imposed outcome.
cases.script:
[[ $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t passwd) == builtin ]] || exit 125
export LC_ALL=C
for d in reference-missing reference-existing candidate-missing candidate-existing; do
  [[ -d $PWD/$d/etc && ! -L $PWD/$d && ! -L $PWD/$d/etc ]] || exit 125
  [[ $(/usr/bin/realpath "$PWD/$d") == "$PWD/$d" ]] || exit 125
  /usr/bin/chmod 600 "$d/etc/shadow" "$d/etc/gshadow" || exit 125
done
for d in candidate-missing candidate-existing; do
  /usr/bin/chown 0:0 "$PWD/$d/etc" "$PWD/$d/etc/"* || exit 125
done
/usr/bin/mkdir "$HOME/before" || exit 125
for f in passwd group shadow gshadow; do /usr/bin/cp "reference-missing/etc/$f" "$HOME/before/$f" || exit 125; done
/usr/sbin/useradd --root "$PWD/reference-missing" --no-create-home --no-user-group -u 2001 -g 2001 -d /home/erin -s /bin/sh erin > "$HOME/reference-missing.out" 2> "$HOME/reference-missing.err"
rmrc=$?
/usr/sbin/useradd --root "$PWD/reference-existing" --no-create-home --no-user-group -u 2001 -g 100 -d /home/erin -s /bin/sh erin > "$HOME/reference-existing.out" 2> "$HOME/reference-existing.err"
rerc=$?
export BASHPASSWD_KERNEL_SECRETS=0 PHCLIB_M=1024 PHCLIB_T=1 PHCLIB_P=1
for kind in missing existing; do
  if [[ $kind == missing ]]; then gid=2001; else gid=100; fi
  PHCLIB_PASSWD="$PWD/candidate-$kind/etc/passwd" PHCLIB_GROUP="$PWD/candidate-$kind/etc/group" PHCLIB_SHADOW="$PWD/candidate-$kind/etc/shadow" /usr/bin/python3 -I /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/passwd-syscall-diagnostic-r16.py --log "$HOME/trace-$kind.json" -- /opt/bashos-parity/candidate --noprofile --norc -c 'passwd add-fd "$@"' passwd erin 3 -u 2001 -g "$gid" -d /home/erin -s /bin/sh 3< pw > "$HOME/candidate-$kind.out" 2> "$HOME/candidate-$kind.err"
  rc=$?
  [[ $kind != existing ]] || candidate_existing_rc=$rc
  printf 'candidate-%s-status=%s\n' "$kind" "$rc" >> "$HOME/candidate-observations.txt"
  /usr/bin/cat "candidate-$kind/etc/passwd" "candidate-$kind/etc/group" "candidate-$kind/etc/shadow" >> "$HOME/candidate-observations.txt" || exit 125
done
printf 'reference-missing-status=%s\nreference-existing-status=%s\n' "$rmrc" "$rerc" > "$HOME/reference-status.txt"
(( rmrc != 0 )) || exit 10
/usr/bin/grep -Eiq 'group.*2001.*(exist|not found|unknown)' "$HOME/reference-missing.err" || exit 11
for f in passwd group shadow gshadow; do /usr/bin/cmp -s "reference-missing/etc/$f" "$HOME/before/$f" || exit 12; done
(( rerc == 0 )) || exit 13
/usr/bin/grep -Eq '^erin:x:2001:100:' reference-existing/etc/passwd || exit 14
/usr/bin/grep -Eq '^users:[^:]*:100:' reference-existing/etc/group || exit 15
(( candidate_existing_rc == 0 )) || exit 16
printf 'reference-missing=nonzero-group-diagnostic-unchanged\nreference-existing=success-uid2001-gid100\ncandidate=observations-recorded\n'
